load_model_predictions: load model predictions from pickle or CSV files in a directory and compute top-1 accuracy
load_annotations: load ImageNet-X annotations for a given partition and factor selection as a DataFrame
augment_model_predictions: merge model predictions with annotations and add correctness and metaclass columns
softmax: compute numerically stable softmax over a numpy array along a specified axis
is_correct_real: check if predicted classes match real multi-label ground truth labels for ImageNet validation images
